name: Bijnor
summary: Official Uttar Pradesh land-records custody and Bijnor-specific cadastral digitization metadata were verified, but no anonymous parcel geometry or safe native parcel identity was verified. No GeoJSON sample is retained.
queryOutcomes: English and Hindi first-party discovery queries both located the official UP Bhulekh/Revenue Council and UP BhuNaksha services. The public dashboard returned Bijnor district/tehsil digitization metadata. The current BhuNaksha frontend exposed login/CAPTCHA and advertised map APIs; bounded anonymous bootstrap retries timed out for mapLevelCount and loginLevel.
requestOutcomes: Successful public GETs: Bijnor district dashboard, Bijnor tehsil dashboard, both dashboard data routes, and current BhuNaksha login frontend. The frontend configuration was inspected for endpoint names and level/administrative codes. No credentials, CAPTCHA, private tokens, unsafe owner/address fields, or exact-point parcel claim were used.
scopeLimits: Bijnor tehsil digitization counts are coverage metadata, not proof that Bijnor city has open parcel polygons.
No city map extent, CRS, parcel schema, or native parcel identity was returned.
No exact-point hit or miss was treated as citywide absence.
No sample GeoJSON is retained because no full safe parcel polygon was obtained.
uncertainty: Urban versus rural coverage at the WUP point remains unresolved; the dashboard contains village/mapsheet digitization status but not a public Bijnor city parcel extract. A timeout is recorded only as a route failure, not as evidence of source absence.
admissionDecision: Do not admit or enable a runtime adapter. Serial reviewer must independently qualify a real Bijnor parcel response with stable native identity, geometry validity, CRS, and geographic scope.
